The refunds table matches Alpha's report exactly. The orders show three customers (acme, birch, cobalt), so I'll get each one's net balance before recording payouts, starting with acme.
acme's net balance is 36083, which matches its orders (18974 + 17109 = 36083) with no refunds, so the figure checks out. I'll get birch's net balance next.
birch's net balance is 28695, which matches its orders (21055 + 11644 = 32699) minus the order 234 refund of 4004. That checks out. Next I need cobalt's net balance.

Cobalt checks out: orders 14171 + 16756 = 30927, minus the order 235 refund of 1660 gives 29267, which matches. All three balances reconcile with the orders and refunds, so I'll record payouts, starting with acme at 36083.
Acme's payout is recorded. Next I'll record birch's payout at its verified net balance of 28695.
Acme and birch are paid, and cobalt's balance of 29267 was already verified against its orders and the order 235 refund. I'll record cobalt's payout to finish the batch.
All three payouts are recorded and each matched its verified net balance. The batch is finished, so I'm closing it out with the payout report.
